auli-getaway.title: Auli Getaway
auli-getaway.subtitle: 3 Days · ₹9,999 · Alpine Meadows
auli-getaway.description: A high meadow above Joshimath, with seasonal snow and views toward Nanda Devi.
auli-getaway.highlights: Alpine meadow walks, ropeway, ski slopes, Nanda Devi vistas

chopta-tungnath-trek.title: Chopta Tungnath Trek
chopta-tungnath-trek.subtitle: 4 Days · ₹12,999 · Highest Shiva Temple
chopta-tungnath-trek.description: Trek through rhododendron forests to the highest Shiva temple on earth and the Chandrashila summit.
chopta-tungnath-trek.highlights: Tungnath Temple, Chandrashila 360° summit views, Deoriatal lake camp

nanda-devi-base-camp.title: Nanda Devi Base Camp
nanda-devi-base-camp.subtitle: 7 Days · ₹21,999 · High Altitude Expedition
nanda-devi-base-camp.description: A wilderness trail into the outer sanctuary threshold facing the majestic twin peaks of Nanda Devi.
nanda-devi-base-camp.highlights: Glacial moraines, alpine wildlife, high altitude bivouac, pristine flora

village-homestay-chamoli.title: Village Homestay Chamoli
village-homestay-chamoli.subtitle: 2 Days · ₹3,999 · Cultural Immersion
village-homestay-chamoli.description: Experience authentic Kumaoni and Garhwali hospitality, organic farm-to-table meals and village crafts.
village-homestay-chamoli.highlights: Traditional wood-slate homestay, Chulha cooking, folk storytelling, terrace farming

munsiyari-johar-route.title: Munsiyari Johar Route
munsiyari-johar-route.subtitle: 5 Days · ₹15,999 · Panchachuli Views

munsiyari-johar-route.highlights: Panchachuli viewpoint, Darkot handloom village, Maheshwari Kund, alpine meadows

rishikesh-yoga-retreat.title: Rishikesh Yoga & Ganga Retreat
rishikesh-yoga-retreat.subtitle: 4 Days · ₹11,499 · Spiritual Wellness

rishikesh-yoga-retreat.highlights: Riverside meditation, sound healing sessions, organic sattvic diet, ashram walks

roopkund-mystery-lake-trek.title: Roopkund Mystery Lake Trek
roopkund-mystery-lake-trek.subtitle: 6 Days · ₹18,500 · Chamoli
